Name: StardewValley Mod Manager(SMM)
Author: ralotte
Description:
[b]SMM: Stardew Mod Manager[/b]

SMM is a professional-grade, lightweight utility designed to help StardewValley users manage their mod environment with precision. Organize your complex mod folders and launch your game with your preferred setup instantly.

[b]Core Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Profile Management:[/b] Create and switch between multiple mod profiles effortlessly.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Toggle:[/b] Enable or disable mods with a single click—no need to manually move folders.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI Status Monitoring:[/b] View your SMAPI mod status in real-time to identify issues immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Dependency Validation:[/b] Automatically analyze
[code]manifest.json[/code]files to detect and alert you to missing requirements.[/*]
[*][b]Streamlined Workflow:[/b] Launch the game directly from the manager using your selected profile with one click.[/*]
[/list][b]Getting Started[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/b] is installed.[/*]
[*]Download the latest version of SMM from the 'Files' tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the contents to a folder of your choice.[/*]
[*]You are ready to manage your mod profiles![/*]
[/list][b]Reporting Issues[/b]
If you encounter any bugs or have feature suggestions, please use the [b]Posts[/b] or [b]Bugs[/b] tab on this mod page. When reporting errors, please include your SMAPI log to help us resolve issues more efficiently.
